conclusion.text:
We found the duplicate. Invoice INV-2026-0142 for the February 2026 Pro plan was paid twice: PAY-88212 and PAY-88213, each 49.00 yuan, both settled on 2 February 2026. One of these, PAY-88213, is the extra payment.

We have proposed a refund of 49.00 yuan to PAY-88213. The refund requires approval before it is issued; we cannot confirm a date for it. No refund has been processed yet.

Your other invoices in the records shown each had a single matching payment.
